period: CY2028 and CY2029 full-year equivalent, not strict fiscal quarter build
scenario_status: all endpoint values independent scenarios; no probabilities
formula: revenue=sum(anchor × growth_factor × share_factor); OP=sum(segment revenue × OPM)−unallocated; pretax=OP+net_finance; tax=max(pretax,0)×rate; NI=pretax−tax−minority; EPS=NI/diluted shares
growth_method: Revenue-calibrated pipeline when defensible global TAM/share is unavailable. AI-exposed revenue responds to macro spending with subunit elasticity and process/material intensity, non-AI revenue has separate growth. Exposures, elasticity, price/ramp/margins/terminal PE are independent assumptions, not reported market share. share_factor=1 gives no unproven share gain.
model_limitations: Models prioritize a reproducible screening range over a false precision forecast. B/C quality labels explicitly retain uncertainty.
Quarter/H1 annualization is an anchor only; it is not a company annual earnings forecast or a floor.
Normal R&D, SBC, depreciation and usual acquired intangible amortization remain within operating margins. One-time equity gains/FX windfalls are not extrapolated.
No terminal net cash or interim dividends are added. EPS×PE valuation must not be described as full DCF.
For loss cases PE valuation is undefined, not a zero valuation of assets.
Future normal interest/associated-company income may embed cash earnings, so a separate cash valuation requires reconciliation.
source_access: All twelve latest primary results were checked on 2026-10-18 via issuer/SEC/JPX web plus issuer-hosted downloads when web extraction failed. Saved public files are in /private/tmp/ai-wide-*.pdf/txt; no authentication or paid data.

companies.name: イビデン
companies.method: CPU/GPU/スイッチ基板の大型・多層化と価格/新ライン歩留まりを電子へ。会社550bnをQ1売上構成で校正するため部門年売上は独自配分。遊休設備償却を金融等費用に残し、株売却益を除外。
risks: 基準利益率31%は不足プレミアム・稼働率と新棟歩留まりに依存
膨大なcapexのCF支出はPERモデルに含まれず、償却とCFを分ける
同日付近説明PDFの数値と正式8/4短信に不整合があるため正式短信を優先した。旧メモの580/120/70bnを使用しない
companies.terminal_pe_basis: 高付加価値基板の技術・顧客認定を評価するが、顧客集中・価格循環・巨額capexを反映して基準24倍。
companies.share_basis: 1/1と10/1の各1:2分割を混同しない。Q1希薄化NI/EPS×2≈0.5898bn（CB利息調整等で概数）と7月転換を踏まえ将来0.600/0.606bn。

companies.method: SoC/メモリのテスト複雑化とAI設備増を半導体テストへ、Product Test・ロボティクスは別の低い感応度へ接続。Advantestとの競争によるシェア上昇を無条件に仮定しない。
risks: 半導体テストの急増四半期からの校正。Q3会社予想はQ2より低い売上を示す

companies.terminal_pe_basis: AIテストの成長・製品多様性を評価し基準26倍。競争・非半導体の収益性を加味し最上位の独占倍率を自動適用しない。
companies.share_basis: 最新Q2希薄化157.7m。将来160/162m、未発表買戻しは含まない。
